description: This is a Java source file defining the 'NsdChatActivity' class, which manages an Android activity for a network service discovery (NSD) chat application. It handles UI interactions, service discovery, registration, connection management, and chat messaging.

classes.name: NsdChatActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that provides UI controls and logic for NSD-based chat communication, including discovering, registering, connecting, and messaging over network services.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and defines the message handler.

methods.name: clickAdvertise
methods.description: Handles the register service button click, registers the local service if socket is bound.

methods.name: clickDiscover
methods.description: Starts service discovery for other NSD services.

methods.name: clickConnect
methods.description: Connects to the selected discovered service.

methods.name: clickSend
methods.description: Sends a chat message via the active connection.

methods.name: addChatLine
methods.description: Appends a chat message line to the chat history TextView.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the network discovery helper and connection object.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops service discovery when activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes service discovery when activity returns to foreground.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Tears down NSD helper and connection objects to clean resources.
